decisions.reason: As the flagship product line of the firm's organic expansion, close to its core salami competence, the platter shows no sign of falling below aspirations, so management has no reason to start problemistic search.
The premium sharing snack line is a low-risk extension of salami expertise in a growing industry, and although the poultry snack B was dropped, there is no evidence that C falls short of aspirations.

The organic Fleischwurst was only recently launched on its own page and fits the strategic organic line, so the firm's slack in a growing market lets it carry the product while its results are still uncertain.

The organic sliced chicken breast line with several variants supports the organic expansion and is too new to be judged against aspirations, so management keeps it despite the earlier withdrawal of a poultry item.
The organic herb-coated salami sits close to the core salami competence and the organic focus, and nothing suggests a shortfall that would justify redirecting its resources.
